local p = {}

-- The recipe card (the look of the item / skill cards) built from the data stored on the wiki (sync_wiki_data.py), so the crafting API is not
-- asked on every page view. Only the Recipe Cost (it follows the market) comes live: Template:RecipeBox
-- sends it in the argument "cost".
local IconName = require('Module:IconName')
local Store = require('Module:DataStore')
local Tooltip = require('Module:Tooltip')   -- stored() and flat(), for the hover cards

local function trim(s)
	return mw.text.trim(tostring(s or ''))
end

local function esc(s)
	return mw.text.encode(tostring(s or ''), '<>&"\'%[%]{}|')
end

-- Where the box sits on the page (float parameter), inline style
local STYLES = {
	right = 'float:right; clear:right; margin:0 0 0.5em 1em;',
	left = 'float:left; clear:left; margin:0 1em 0.5em 0;',
	center = 'width:fit-content; max-width:100%; margin:0.5em auto;',
}

local function num(n)
	n = tonumber(n)
	if not n then return '' end
	if n == math.floor(n) then return string.format('%d', n) end
	return tostring(n)
end

-- Icon with border, name in the grade colour, amount (what Template:Item shows)
local function itemHtml(frame, name, grade, amount, icon, over)
	grade = trim(grade)
	if grade == '' or grade == 'None' or grade == 'Any' then grade = 'Basic' end
	local out = Tooltip.itemLine(frame, IconName.icon({ args = { name, grade, file = icon or '', over = over or '' } }), grade, name, nil, true)
	if amount and amount ~= '' then out = out .. ' × ' .. esc(amount) end
	return out
end

local function coins(frame, copper)
	return frame:expandTemplate{ title = 'Coins', args = { num(copper) } }
end

-- Hover card of an item: the tooltip card ({{Tooltip}}) in the hidden box that Template:Item/styles.css opens on hover.
-- Only for items whose card data is stored (no live requests). left = the card opens to the left.
local function hoverWrap(frame, inner, id, left, extraClass, grade)
	id = tonumber(id)
	if not id or Tooltip.stored({ args = { id } }) == '' then
		return '<span class="' .. (extraClass or '') .. '">' .. inner .. '</span>'
	end
	local card = Tooltip.flatCard(frame, id, nil, grade)   -- grade: the card opens with the grade of the product
	return '<span class="aa-itemtip' .. (left and ' aa-itemtip-left' or '') .. (extraClass and (' ' .. extraClass) or '') .. '">'
		.. inner .. '<span class="aa-itemtip-card">' .. card .. '</span></span>'
end

-- The box for the arguments a = { id, float, cost }. cost is the live Recipe Cost; when it is not given (the row
-- function) it is fetched here with Template:RecipeBox/cost.
local function build(frame, a)
	local r = Store.get('Recipes', a.id)
	if not r or not r.product then return '' end

	local float = trim(a.float):lower()
	local style = STYLES[float] or 'margin:0.5em 0;'
	-- a box on the right side opens the hover cards to the left, so they stay on the screen
	local left = float == 'right'
	local root = mw.html.create('div'):addClass('aa-recipebox aa-rb')
	if float == 'right' or float == 'left' then root:addClass('aa-recipebox-float') end
	root:attr('style', style)
	-- the styles of the hover cards of the items
	root:wikitext(frame:extensionTag{ name = 'templatestyles', args = { src = 'Template:Item/styles.css' } })

	-- header: the product (icon, name, grade; hover = its card) and the chance for 2x
	local prod = r.product
	local grade = trim(prod.grade)
	local hasGrade = not (grade == '' or grade == 'None' or grade == 'Any')
	local pgrade = hasGrade and grade or 'Basic'
	local head = root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-rb-head')
	local title = mw.html.create('span'):addClass('aa-rb-title')
	title:tag('span'):addClass('aa-rb-kind'):wikitext('Recipe')
	local name = frame:expandTemplate{ title = 'Grade', args = { pgrade, esc(prod.name) } }
	local amount = tonumber(prod.amount)
	if amount and amount > 1 then name = name .. ' × ' .. num(amount) end
	title:tag('span'):addClass('aa-rb-name'):wikitext(name)
	if hasGrade then
		title:tag('span'):addClass('aa-rb-grade'):wikitext(frame:expandTemplate{ title = 'Grade', args = { grade, esc(grade) } })
	end
	local icon = IconName.icon({ args = { prod.name, pgrade, size = 48, file = prod.icon or '', over = prod.over or '' } })
	head:wikitext(hoverWrap(frame, '<span class="aa-rb-icon">' .. icon .. '</span>' .. tostring(title), prod.id, left, 'aa-rb-prod', hasGrade and grade or nil))
	-- "Chance for 2x": the data says 100 + the extra percent; 10000 and the like are another scale
	local rate = tonumber(r.rate)
	if rate and rate > 100 and rate < 1000 then
		local chip = head:tag('span'):addClass('aa-rb-chip')
		chip:tag('span'):addClass('aa-rb-chiplabel'):wikitext('Chance for 2x')
		chip:wikitext(num(math.floor((rate - 100) * 10 + 0.5) / 10) .. '%')
	end

	root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-rb-sep')

	-- Labor and Proficiency share the first line, the Workbench gets the line below
	local stats = root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-rb-stats')
	local function stat(row, label, value, class)
		local cell = row:tag('div')
		cell:tag('div'):addClass('aa-rb-label'):wikitext(label)
		cell:tag('div'):addClass('aa-rb-value' .. (class and (' ' .. class) or '')):wikitext(value)
	end
	local row1 = stats:tag('div'):addClass('aa-rb-statrow')
	if r.labor then stat(row1, 'Labor', num(r.labor), 'aa-rb-labor') end
	if r.prof then
		local text = esc(r.prof)
		local req = tonumber(r.req)
		if req and req ~= 0 then
			text = text .. ' ' .. mw.language.getContentLanguage():formatNum(req)
		end
		stat(row1, 'Proficiency', text)
	end
	if r.station then stat(stats:tag('div'):addClass('aa-rb-statrow'), 'Workbench', esc(r.station)) end

	root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-rb-sep')

	-- the materials: item (icon, name, hover card) and the amount in a column of its own
	root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-rb-label aa-rb-mats'):wikitext('Materials')
	local list = root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-rb-list')
	for _, m in ipairs(r.materials or {}) do
		local g = trim(m.required)
		if g == '' or g == 'Any' then g = m.grade or '' end
		local line = list:tag('div'):addClass('aa-rb-row')
		local item
		item = Tooltip.itemTip(frame, { id = m.id, grade = g, size = 32, flex = true, tip = left and 'left' or '' })
		if not item then
			item = itemHtml(frame, m.name, g, nil, m.icon, m.over)
		end
		line:tag('span'):addClass('aa-rb-item'):wikitext(item)
		line:tag('span'):addClass('aa-rb-amount'):wikitext('× ' .. num(m.amount))
	end
	local coin = tonumber(r.coin)
	if coin and coin > 0 then
		local line = list:tag('div'):addClass('aa-rb-row')
		line:tag('span'):addClass('aa-rb-item aa-rb-coinlabel'):wikitext('[[File:Gold.png|24px|link=]] Coins')
		line:tag('span'):addClass('aa-rb-amount'):wikitext(coins(frame, coin))
	end

	-- live from the market; a failed request leaves an error text, then there is no footer
	local cost = a.cost
	if cost == nil then cost = frame:expandTemplate{ title = 'RecipeBox/cost', args = { trim(a.id) } } end
	cost = trim(cost)
	if not cost:find('class="error"', 1, true) then
		cost = tonumber(cost)
		if cost and cost > 0 then
			root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-rb-sep')
			local foot = root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-rb-foot')
			local lab = foot:tag('span')
			lab:tag('span'):addClass('aa-rb-costlabel'):wikitext('[https://sermeatball.com/tools/crafting/' .. trim(a.id) .. ' Recipe Cost]')
			lab:tag('span'):addClass('aa-rb-note'):wikitext('follows the market')
			foot:tag('span'):addClass('aa-rb-cost'):wikitext(coins(frame, cost))
		end
	end

	return tostring(root)
end

-- The box of one recipe from the stored data, or (a recipe that is not stored yet) the old live template
-- Template:RecipeBox/live. Done here so there is no #if layer around the box.
function p.box(frame) return build(frame, frame.args) end

local function boxOrLive(frame, a)
	if Store.get('Recipes', a.id) then return build(frame, a) end
	return frame:expandTemplate{ title = 'RecipeBox/live', args = { a.id, float = a.float } }
end

-- {{#invoke:RecipeBox|boxOrLive}}: one box (Template:RecipeBox)
function p.boxOrLive(frame)
	local a = frame.args
	return boxOrLive(frame, { id = a.id, float = a.float, cost = a.cost })
end

-- {{RecipeRow|id|id|id|em=0.5}} (Template:RecipeRow): boxes next to each other in a row that wraps. All the boxes are made
-- here in ONE step. Boxes put in {{Div|...}} are counted several times against the size limit of the page
-- (each template layer counts the whole text again), so a page with many boxes stopped showing the last ones.
function p.row(frame)
	local args = frame:getParent().args
	local gap = tonumber(trim(args.em))
	if not gap or gap < 0 then gap = 0.5 end
	local keys = {}
	for k in pairs(args) do
		if type(k) == 'number' then keys[#keys + 1] = k end
	end
	table.sort(keys)

	local root = mw.html.create('div'):css('display', 'flex'):css('gap', gap .. 'em'):css('flex-wrap', 'wrap'):css('align-items', 'flex-start')
	local any = false
	for _, k in ipairs(keys) do
		local id = trim(args[k])
		if id ~= '' then
			root:tag('div'):wikitext(boxOrLive(frame, { id = id, float = '' }))
			any = true
		end
	end
	if not any then return '' end
	return frame:extensionTag{ name = 'templatestyles', args = { src = 'Template:RecipeBox/styles.css' } } .. tostring(root)
end

return p
